title: PWA Configuration
description: Learn how to configure Progressive Web App (PWA) features to make your store installable and work offline.
content:
PWA Configuration

Progressive Web App (PWA) features make your store installable on mobile devices and work offline, providing an app-like experience.

PWA Features

PWA provides:

  • Installable on mobile devices
  • Offline functionality
  • App-like experience
  • Push notifications
  • Fast loading
  • Home screen icon

Enabling PWA

Step 1: Check Plan Support

Ensure your subscription plan includes PWA support.

Step 2: Access PWA Settings

Navigate to Store Settings → PWA to configure PWA features.

Step 3: Configure PWA

Set up PWA settings:

  • App name
  • Short name
  • Description
  • Theme color
  • Background color
  • Icons (various sizes)

Step 4: Enable PWA

Toggle PWA to enabled and save settings.

PWA Icons

Upload icons for your PWA:

  • 192x192 icon (required)
  • 512x512 icon (required)
  • Additional sizes (optional)
  • Apple touch icon
  • Favicon

Offline Functionality

Configure offline features:

  • Cache product pages
  • Cache category pages
  • Offline page
  • Service worker configuration

Push Notifications

Enable push notifications:

  • Order updates
  • Promotional messages
  • Abandoned cart reminders
  • Customer opt-in required

Installation

Customers can install your store:

  • On Android: Add to home screen prompt
  • On iOS: Add to home screen from Safari
  • On desktop: Install button in browser

Testing PWA

Test PWA functionality:

  • Test installation
  • Test offline mode
  • Test push notifications
  • Verify icons display correctly
  • Check on different devices

Best Practices

  • Use high-quality icons
  • Optimize for performance
  • Test on multiple devices
  • Provide offline content
  • Request notification permission appropriately
  • Keep PWA updated
